questions.stem: A 36-year lady presents with menorrhagia. On evaluation she is found to have a large intramural fibroid. A myomectomy is planned. All are beneficial in reducing blood loss during surgery except?
questions.stemHtml: A 36-year lady presents with menorrhagia. On evaluation she is found to have a large intramural fibroid. A myomectomy is planned. All are beneficial in reducing blood loss during surgery except?

options.label: C
options.text: Ligation of vessels over the surface of the myoma

options.label: D
options.text: Use of vasopressin along the planned serosal incision
